key_findings.finding: Card1=2157 is a long-established, high-volume entity with 807 prior transactions, 661 of them on this same addr1, indicating a stable legitimate cardholder-address pairing rather than a burst pattern.
Mature (21-day-settled) fraud rates for the entity are all at or below the ~3.5% base rate: card1 1.15%, card1|addr1 1.05%, and card1|email 0.0%.
No gang signature: gang_score is low (0.115) and fan-out is modest relative to volume (31 addr1 / 17 email / 11 device across 807 txns).
Categorical attributes carry no elevated risk: ProductCD=W 2.09%, aol.com 2.23%, visa 3.48%, all at/below the 3.5% base rate; amount is modest ($226).

No risk rules fired, and 3 of 4 similar cases on this same card1 were high-score false positives manually cleared; the single confirmed-fraud analog (CASE_000) differed by having missing email/device, whereas this txn has an established email with 0% card1|email fraud.
The independent evidence corroborates rather than conflicts with the low upstream GBDT score (p=0.0015).

report.disposition_rationale: Established high-volume entity, mature fraud rates below base, no gang signature, no rules fired, benign categoricals, and similar-case precedent leaning toward false positives. Independent evidence supports the low GBDT score. Fraud probability is low and amount is modest, so approving is the lowest-expected-cost action.
report.summary: Transaction 3529881 ($226, ProductCD=W, visa/debit, aol.com) runs on card1=2157, a stable high-volume entity with 807 priors and 661 on the same address. All mature fraud rates are below the ~3.5% base rate (card1 1.15%, card1|email 0.0%), gang_score is low (0.115), fan-out is modest for the volume, and no rules fired. Categorical attributes are benign. Similar historical cases on this card were predominantly cleared false positives; the one confirmed-fraud analog lacked email/device, unlike this present-email transaction. The independent evidence corroborates the low upstream score, so this is a low-risk transaction and is approved.
